commit_message:
[Integrate] Update torch-mlir to f843f738 (#25196)

Updates torch-mlir from its October 29 upstream baseline to
[`llvm/torch-mlir@f843f738`](https://github.com/llvm/torch-mlir/commit/f843f7386b422477a1570307fa5e5c12527193e0),
using
[`iree-org/torch-mlir@68244564`](https://github.com/iree-org/torch-mlir/commit/68244564a58e6eb48f15460dff217c135da631f6)
(`sm-iree-integrates/torch-20261104`) adapted to IREE's current LLVM
revision.

On top of canonical torch-mlir, the integration branch carries only the
LLVM submodule bump, now pointing at IREE's current LLVM and StableHLO
pins. The previous pin carried no other adaptation patches, so none were
dropped.

The PT2E quantize/dequantize verifier from llvm/torch-mlir#4848 rejects
an out-of-range per-channel axis and a group size that does not divide
the last input dimension. `@out_of_range_axis` and
`@indivisible_group_size` in `quantization_to_linalg_ext.mlir` built
such IR and are removed.

ONNX op test expectations: no changes in the CPU or GPU configs.

Assisted by: Claude

Signed-off-by: Roberto Laudani <laudani@roofline.ai>

commit_message:
[Build][AMDGPU] Use bitcode from the official ROCM distribution (#25133)

With the sunset of the old artifacts from
`shark-infra/amdgpu-device-libs`, migrate to LLVM bitcode blobs from the
official distribution. The version shall be pinned in
`build_tools/third_party/amdgpu_device_libs/rocm_package.json`.

This increases the bitcode download to 146Mb (in comparison, the WASI
SDK weighs in at <120Mb). Considering we're only using less than 1Mb,
that's unfortunate, but at the moment it's the only way to use the
official maintained source.

Fixes #25131.

commit_message:
[Integrate] Update torch-mlir to f843f738 (#25196)

Updates torch-mlir from its October 29 upstream baseline to
[`llvm/torch-mlir@f843f738`](https://github.com/llvm/torch-mlir/commit/f843f7386b422477a1570307fa5e5c12527193e0),
using
[`iree-org/torch-mlir@68244564`](https://github.com/iree-org/torch-mlir/commit/68244564a58e6eb48f15460dff217c135da631f6)
(`sm-iree-integrates/torch-20261104`) adapted to IREE's current LLVM
revision.

On top of canonical torch-mlir, the integration branch carries only the
LLVM submodule bump, now pointing at IREE's current LLVM and StableHLO
pins. The previous pin carried no other adaptation patches, so none were
dropped.

The PT2E quantize/dequantize verifier from llvm/torch-mlir#4848 rejects
an out-of-range per-channel axis and a group size that does not divide
the last input dimension. `@out_of_range_axis` and
`@indivisible_group_size` in `quantization_to_linalg_ext.mlir` built
such IR and are removed.

ONNX op test expectations: no changes in the CPU or GPU configs.

Assisted by: Claude

Signed-off-by: Roberto Laudani <laudani@roofline.ai>

[Build][AMDGPU] Use bitcode from the official ROCM distribution (#25133)

With the sunset of the old artifacts from
`shark-infra/amdgpu-device-libs`, migrate to LLVM bitcode blobs from the
official distribution. The version shall be pinned in
`build_tools/third_party/amdgpu_device_libs/rocm_package.json`.

This increases the bitcode download to 146Mb (in comparison, the WASI
SDK weighs in at <120Mb). Considering we're only using less than 1Mb,
that's unfortunate, but at the moment it's the only way to use the
official maintained source.

Fixes #25131.
